game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – String Glue: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Concatenate string pieces to forge passwords and spell names. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the fire warden ahead. Then check the spell_ok value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ash barrier by solving code steps involving spell_ok that move the fire warden forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ash barrier first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): String Glue
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'String Glue' (Week 2 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spell_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
